synopsis: CARISSMA in Germany is named alongside CEREMA, NIED and JARI as a main source of ground truth for weather models and, together with proving grounds, for validating sensor models [f16122, f5056, f5119]. The booklet identifies fog chambers at these facilities as sources of sensor-model ground truth; fog is described as the best-reproduced condition for lidar, with CARISSMA, CEREMA and JARI providing on-road evidence [f15594, f4640]. Haider et al. (2023) studied lidar rain and fog at NIED and CARISSMA [f4731]. However, the research did not establish facility booking lead times, capacity or suitability for heavy off-road machines of the relevant size, leaving access questions that directly affect validation before mid-2027 [f16124, f5120].
